loadedSyntamark.reason: The LSP protocol does not expose loaded runtime/embedded Source identity. See paired site/Generator provenance; do not infer this from package declarations.

latency.reference: Monotonic raw milliseconds from didChange to accepted diagnostics; debounce 50ms included. Warmups excluded. Burst shape is sequential edits without an extra gap.

workerNodeRss.reason: Worker process RSS is not sampled by this harness.

executionOutcome.cleanup: Harness returned normally after all owned LSP processes exited; no external stop.

limitations: Only 100 pages, one Windows computer; no 1000/10000-page or cross-OS reference.
Three Blog/Docs process runs per target; overlapping ranges do not establish small performance changes.
One MDX process per target, no MDX ratio conclusion.
Generator header scan excludes schema binding, emission, Roslyn and C# compilation.
Editor has 20 edits per shape/language and a 40-edit restart soak, not a long-duration soak or Extension Host benchmark.
Verification stages overlap execution. Worker heap snapshots are not peak RSS. Unmeasured worker RSS and editor loaded-dependency identity remain unavailable.

machine.conditions: Sequential fresh processes, no concurrent authorized builds/tests/browser work; OS cache is not reset. AC power mode is not changed by the harness.
